text:
## Decision Authority Matrix  
| Decision Type | Authority | Limit | Escalation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fee Reversal | Manager | £1,000 | Director if >£1k |
| Complaint Resolution | Manager | £5,000 | CRO if >£5k |
| Fraud Reimbursement | Compliance | £10,000 | CEO if >£10k |
| KYC Exception | Compliance Head | Any | CRO if PEP/sanctions |
| Product Exception | Product Manager | £50,000 | Board if >£50k |
| Lending Exception | Underwriter | Credit policy | CRO if policy violation |
| System Expenditure | CTO | £50,000 | CFO if >£50k |
| Vendor Contract | Department Head | £100,000 | CEO if >£100k |
